_comment: 'default' is used when the user's language is NOT supported or when the app is opened for the first time — it determines which language version of static content (e.g., banners, images, default titles) is shown.
_comment2: 'default' is NOT the same as the i18n fallback. 'fallback' is ALWAYS English — it ensures consistent translations when a specific translation key is missing in the selected language.
_comment3: ⚠️ IMPORTANT: Do NOT put any comments or non-language keys inside 'supported'. Only language codes are allowed!
